title: BDP v0.1 staged schema bundle
description: Staged JSON Schema2020-12 artifact for the v0.1 selected-contract binding. Version and optional capability discovery are explicit; remaining inherited profile, Type, Event and advanced grammar is not an adoption or retention commitment. Complete retained-surface composition is required before advertising v0.1. The separate v0 artifact remains unchanged for held runtime/evidence.

absoluteHttpUrl.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL used for canonical in-Scope identities and discovered navigation. Equality, canonical path spelling, ownership and non-reuse are additionally governed by the Scope rules.

absoluteUri.description: Absolute URI carried for an opaque out-of-Scope Link endpoint or other explicitly URI-valued context. This syntax supplies no existence, kind, access or immutability guarantee.

bdpVersion.description: Exact protocol-version discriminator. Version 0.1 selects this complete draft contract rather than an executable, a Git revision or a capability range.

retryDisposition.description: Protocol retry guidance. A refusal does not authorize changing semantic intent or minting a fresh execution key to evade durable no-reexecution.

readProblemCode.description: Closed vocabulary of Core read diagnoses, including bounded History missing-state failures. HTTP disclosure and precedence rules still govern which diagnosis can be exposed.

readProblem.description: Core Problem Details carrier. Type/code/status/retry combinations and History-specific fields are constrained together; schema validity alone does not prove the original request was authorized.

status.description: HTTP status associated with this Problem; protocol decision order remains binding.

next.description: Absolute continuation URL, or explicit null only when the admitted finite traversal is exhausted.

positiveInteger.description: Positive integral JSON number used for a declared bound or count. Implementations must preserve the specified numeric value rather than rely on a language-specific integer class.

iso8601Duration.description: ISO 8601 duration string used for advertised lifetimes. The containing contract determines the promised interval and forbids silently shortening issued obligations.

maximumEndpointMultiplicityPolicy.description: Native Scope constraint over stored in-Scope Link incidence. It names the Link family, endpoint role and positive maximum; it does not inspect a foreign authority’s Link table.

endpoint.description: Endpoint role to which the native incidence maximum applies.

linkConformsTo.description: Nominal Link-Type family constrained by this native policy.

max.description: Positive maximum for the explicitly selected Scope policy.

reference.description: A floating absolute URI or an exact URI-and-revision pair. The containing field determines whether only HTTP(S) identities are admissible; a pin is never merged with another Reference.

pinnedReference.description: Complete exact Reference. Both URI and nonempty opaque revision are mandatory, with no undeclared members. Its revision denotes recorded content, not an implicit current selector.

revision.description: Concrete nonempty opaque revision of the recorded Resource or exact target. It is not ordered or replaced by a current selector.

uri.description: Complete target identity carried by this Reference. Relative paths and partial Reference objects are not admitted.

jsonPointer.description: JSON Pointer carrier. Pointer evaluation, escaping and projection restrictions are defined by the selected operation; a syntactically valid pointer alone grants no access.

ordinaryUpdateChange.description: An ordinary update input may supply no patch operations; a supplied array member is still required.

resourceKind.description: The two protocol Resource kinds. Kind is immutable and established by the resolved Resource, never inferred from its URL path.

resourceIdentity.description: Complete identity, Type affiliation and concrete revision recorded for a Resource, including a deletion fact. It is not a live Resource postimage and carries no mutable properties.

id.description: Absolute canonical immutable Resource identity URL.

revision.description: Concrete nonempty opaque revision of the recorded Resource version.

type.description: Complete recorded Type affiliation, preserving any revision pin.

wireToken.description: Nonempty opaque token whose scope and meaning are determined by its containing cursor, fact or correlation field. Tokens from different namespaces are not interchangeable.

revision.description: Nonempty opaque Resource-version token. Clients compare it for exact equality and cannot infer order, time, allocation or a special current value from its spelling.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 date-time carrier. Emission uses a valid calendar and clock, uppercase T and Z; the prose governs accepted spellings and precision.

selector.description: Nonempty ordinary bounded Selector string. Its candidate-local grammar, limits and admitted operators are defined by Selection; it never silently becomes the structured Query AST.

batchRequest.title: BDP optional atomic batch version 1 request

historyCapability.description: History version-1 advertisement. It commits to the complete exact-read and retained-versions contract, not merely an event timeline or a current-record lookup.

version.description: Exact selected feature version. No version ordering or implicit upgrade is defined.

contextString.description: Explicit immutable context value: present carries a nonempty string, absent records known absence, and undetermined records unavailable knowledge. No state authenticates an agent.

contextMessage.description: Explicit immutable message context: present carries a string, including an empty message; absent and undetermined distinguish known absence from unavailable knowledge.

contextTime.description: Explicit immutable commit-time context: present carries a date-time and undetermined records unavailable knowledge. There is no absent time arm. This envelope is not a timestamp string or a revision-order proof.

historyMissingItem.description: One unavailable component needed for an exact response: the subject record, a selected property path, or captured owned-Link state. The bounded diagnosis preserves known location without substituting current content.

historyMissing.description: Bounded missing-state diagnosis for revision-unretained. Complete states whether the item list is exhaustive; it cannot falsely certify reconstruction or erase undisclosed dependencies.

complete.description: Whether the stated bounded information is exhaustive under the containing contract.

items.description: Finite ordered members of this page or bounded diagnosis. Meaning and completeness follow the containing operation.

historyVersionRow.description: One retained Resource-version summary. Revision, lineage and body completeness describe actual retained version state; deletion is not represented as a synthetic version row.

body.description: Whether the row’s retained version can currently produce its complete recorded representation, including required owned state.

lineage.description: Whether the row belongs to the current or a replaced retained lineage; this is not a revision-order comparison.

revision.description: Concrete nonempty opaque revision of the recorded Resource or exact target. It is not ordered or replaced by a current selector.

revisionProvenance.description: Immutable carried attribution for this concrete version; it authenticates no principal.

complete.description: Whether the stated bounded information is exhaustive under the containing contract.

newest.description: Newest known retained revision or explicit null under the stated window rules.

oldest.description: Oldest known retained revision or explicit null under the stated window rules.

historyVersionsPage.description: Finite all-retained History page. Subject, participation, window, items and next remain explicit, and nonparticipating/undetermined subjects do not acquire invented rows.

items.description: Finite ordered members of this page or bounded diagnosis. Meaning and completeness follow the containing operation.

next.description: Absolute continuation URL, or explicit null only when the admitted finite traversal is exhausted.

population.description: Explicit retained population selector; it does not assert current live membership.

subject.description: Canonical Resource identity to which this retained page or Resource-scoped observation applies.

window.description: Known retained-history boundaries and completeness, never a synthetic history.

historicalBeadRecord.description: Complete exact Bead representation. Current incident-Link aggregates are excluded; captured owned-Link state comes from that recorded version.

historicalLinkRecord.description: Complete exact Link representation retaining its recorded whole source/target and Type References. Current defaults or pins cannot replace them.

revisionActor.description: Recorded principal and explicit attribution basis. Writer-supplied and unknown describe how the value was carried; neither asserts authentication.

basis.description: How the principal value was carried: writer-supplied or unknown. Neither means authenticated.

id.description: Opaque recorded principal identifier, such as agent:planner. It is not a Resource URL or an authentication assertion.

revisionProvenance.description: Optional per-version attribution envelope. Actor attribution is independent of the optional complete committedAt/agent/message tuple; omission does not invent an actor or context.

actor.description: Carried principal attribution and explicit basis, independent of the optional History context tuple.

agent.description: Immutable carried agent label, not an authentication result.

committedAt.description: Immutable recorded commit-time context, present with agent and message as one complete tuple.

message.description: Immutable carried change message, present with committedAt and agent.

capabilityAdvertisements.description: Map from absolute capability identity URI to explicitly supported versions. Unknown optional capabilities can be ignored without changing known base behavior; advertisement is neither request selection nor permission.

https://github.com/gastownhall/bdp/capab.description: Supported atomic-batch versions and their admission detail. Core-only discovery separately prohibits advertising version 1.
Supported Write idempotency versions, each with closed empty detail.
Supported Write exception versions; the Scope does not serve the operations each lists and is not a complete Write provider.
Supported projection versions and their point/exact/inventory support flags.
Supported exact-definition lookup versions; the operation sits at its fixed route.

typeReference.description: A nominal Type affiliation: an absolute HTTP(S) Type identity or an exact pinned Type Reference. Carrying it does not activate Types interpretation.

pinnedTypeReference.description: Exact Type affiliation using an absolute HTTP(S) Type identity and a nonempty opaque revision. Both members travel together.
